hypothesis_description: Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011 JFE 99(2) MAX anomaly pure single-factor validation in KR market. M22_Max_Return (highest single-day return in past month, lower_better direction per factor_registry) — lottery preference predicts high MAX → 1M return underperformance. KR retail 50%+ market structure 정합 가설. Sector neutralized + PIT lockbox <= 2023-12-22 + walk-forward expanding + liq 2e8 t-1 strict. Single-sleeve top20 long-only design (Option a). Result: ICIR_neut=0.264 (PASS gate), Harvey t=3.97 (PASS gate), but rank_ic=0.023 (FAIL gate 0.04), subperiod_stability=0.375 (FAIL gate 0.5), selection-corrected DSR=0.0 (FAIL gate 0.5), AX-001 v2 crisis IC=-0.0195 (defensive FAIL), top20 active return=-0.122%/month t=-0.67 (signal-portfolio break, AX-007 정합 risk).

factor_specs.formula: Max single-day return in past month (calendar window). align_factor_direction (IC-based, lower_better → Z_aligned = Z_Score * -1). Per-Date sector demean + re-standardize sd=1.
factor_specs.lag_rule: Date <= sig_d (computed from t-30d daily returns, lookback period only)
factor_specs.neutralization: sector (per-Date demean), no size or beta neut applied
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Bali-Cakici-Whitelaw 2011: Investors with lottery preference systematically overpay for stocks with recent extreme positive returns. High MAX(t) predicts negative 1M ahead return. KR retail share >50% predicts strong lottery preference. Direction in registry: lower_better. After IC-based alignment, high Z_aligned = low MAX = high expected alpha (defensive direction).
references: Bali, T. G., Cakici, N., & Whitelaw, R. F. (2011). Maxing out: Stocks as lotteries and the cross-section of expected returns. Journal of Financial Economics, 99(2), 427-446.

challenge_flags.description: Bali 2011 is single seminal paper but factor has 200+ subsequent citations and replicated globally. Single-factor pure validation in KR: subperiod_stability=0.375 (FAIL).

DSR with n_trials=269 (factor_db full set as selection denominator) = 0.0 (collapses). Even Bali's 'isolated' single-factor hypothesis is conditional on prior selection from broader candidate set. Pure n_trials=1 baseline DSR=1.0 misleading.

Top 20 sleeve active return = -0.122%/month with negative t-stat (-0.67) over full 226 dates. Even cross-sectional IC is statistically positive (Harvey t=3.97), portfolio-level translation BROKEN. Confirms AX-007 single-sleeve top20 mechanism break — factor exists, sleeve does not.

Bali MAX hypothesized as defensive (lottery preference UP in stress). KR result: crisis_ic=-0.0195 (negative, defensive ROLE BROKEN). Factor works in elevated/normal regimes only. Hypothesis reconceptualization needed: M22 is RISK-ON momentum-cluster factor in KR, not defensive lottery anomaly.

2020-2026 ICIR_neut=0.209 vs 2015-2019=0.498 (-58% magnitude decay). Direction stable (positive sign all subperiods) but compression. AX-005 BAB-type 2020+ family weakening partially supported. Bali MAX 2011 published; 13y arbitrage erosion plausible.

verdict_rationale: Alpha signal exists (cross-sectional IC and ICIR pass minimum gates; Harvey t=3.97 robust to multiple testing in narrow N=1 sense). However: (1) rank_ic 0.023 BELOW 0.04 KR threshold; (2) subperiod stability 0.375 BELOW 0.5; (3) selection-corrected DSR=0 collapses; (4) AX-001 v2 crisis FAIL — defensive role broken; (5) top20 sleeve active = -0.12%/month t=-0.67, signal-portfolio break. Pure single-sleeve top20 long-only graduation FAILS. Honest termination recommended. Two follow-ups conceivable: (a) reconceptualize M22 as risk-on alpha (not defensive) and pair with true defensive in multi-sleeve; (b) test top 50+ diversified or long-short variant (AX-007 exceptions). Both require fresh WT, not retrofit.
follow_up_recommendations: TERMINATE current single-sleeve hypothesis. Do NOT advance to PG1 admission.

Reconceptualize M22 as risk-on / momentum-adjacent factor in KR (regime-conditional ICIR pattern strongly supports). New WT could test M22 long-only top20 GATED by regime (only deploy when elevated/normal).
Or pair M22 with verified defensive factor in multi-sleeve (AX-007 exception 1). Examples: M22 risk-on sleeve + Q11_Net_Margin or D43_Skewness defensive sleeve.

Or test M22 long-short variant (AX-007 exception 2): long low-MAX top 20 / short high-MAX top 20. KR no-short-legal constraint requires ETF inverse or KOSPI 200 future hedge — outside current mandate.
Or scale to 50+ diversified (AX-007 exception 3) — top 50 by Z_neutral, equal-weighted. Likely improves portfolio translation but breaks 20-stock hard constraint (도훈 confirm needed).
